title: Constant density on the support forces constant multiplicity
statement: For all P, n, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), every integer multiplicity triple R = (S, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n representing T, every p ∈ ℝ^P and every ρ ∈ ℝ: if Θⁿ(μ_T, y) = k (HasMassDensity T y k) for every y ∈ spt T ∩ B_ρ(p), then (a) for μ_R-a.e. x, where μ_R := R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞S, x ∈ B_ρ(p) implies θ(x) = k; and (b) θ(x) = k for Hⁿ⌞(S ∩ B_ρ(p))-a.e. x. Here Hⁿ := μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ ball p ρ → R.mult x = k) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ ball p ρ)), R.mult x = k
